summary: Iteration 2 fully tested: backend pytest 50/50 pass (auth, public, user pratica flow with randomized future dates, comune backoffice with L2/L3 for approva/rifiuta, superadmin, RBAC, chat/notifiche, NEW livelli L1/L2/L3 gating, NEW date-overlap 409 + occupazioni endpoint). Frontend Playwright verified: L1 sidebar shows only 2 links (Scrivania + Report) + 'OPERATORE · L1' badge; L3 shows all 5 links + 'RESPONSABILE · L3' badge; on IN_ISTRUTTORIA L1 sees livello-lock-msg and btn-integrazione but NOT btn-approva/btn-rifiuta while L3 sees both; wizard pratica shows occupazioni-box with 10 occupied ranges; selecting overlap dates (2026-05-10 → 2026-05-14) and clicking Avanti triggers wizard-error 'Periodo non disponibile: lo spazio è già impegnato in queste date' from 409 response; landing loads with italy-map + marquee striscia + grain effect intact.

issues: Uses native browser <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker — locale-dependent format may confuse Italian users. Occupazioni-box is well styled but consider a visual calendar overlay to prevent overlap attempts.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grown to 665 lines but still within acceptable single-file limit; if any more features are added, split by router (auth, pratiche, comune, admin).

_periodo_occupato uses string comparison on ISO dates ('YYYY-MM-DD') which works because dates are consistently zero-padded — safe, but a datetime comparison would be more defensive if data ever mixes formats.

STATI_ATTIVI is declared AFTER the endpoint /spazi/{spazio_id}/occupazioni that references it (line 250 uses STATI_ATTIVI defined on line 266). At module import time this works because the endpoint body runs later; but a linter may flag the visual ordering. Cosmetic only.

seed.py `ensure_livelli` is idempotent (guarded with find_one) — good. seed_all still non-idempotent: if seed_all already ran and only ensure_livelli reruns, ensure_livelli won't create Roma L2/L3 users if Roma comune doesn't exist. Not a blocker in current state.

PraticaWizard.jsx: no client-side pre-check of overlap against `occupazioni` before POST — relies on server 409. Consider a visual highlight of overlapping input to reduce round-trips (UX enhancement, not a bug).
BackofficeLayout uses `l[3]` as level threshold in the LINKS tuple — magic-index; a named object `{to, label, testid, minLivello}` would be more readable.
